entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP, Mr. Jharkhandi Upadhyay.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 21-12-2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 18-03-2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 15-06-2017, passed by the learned A.C.J.M-III, Biharsharif,
Nalanda, in Complaint Case No. 33 of 2017, whereby cognizance of Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.57565 of 2017(2) dt.12-12-2023 offence under Section 498A of the IPC has been taken, shall remain stayed.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits petitioners are father-in-law and mother-in-law of the OP No. 2, and whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations in order to coerce the husband into submission.
It is next submitted that the stage of the case from the stage of cognizance till date has not changed.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
